newsitem.title: ISRAEL: IBM signs accord to buy Israeli goods.
newsitem.headline: IBM signs accord to buy Israeli goods.

text.p: IBM has signed a multi-year agreement with Israel's Industrial Cooperation Authority for the purchase of local products, said Ephraim Shoham, acting director general of the Industry and Trade Ministry's authority.
Last year IBM bought $93 million in goods from Israel companies. "We expect that figure to increase this year on the basis of the growth in IBM's purchases here (in recent years)," Shoham said.
Over the past few years IBM's purchases have grown 10 to 20 percent annually.
This included components, hardware and inspection equipment from 35 local companies.
Shoham said IBM is the largest buyer of Israeli goods in the computer field.
The agreement is also expected to encourage the purchase of local goods by IBM Israel, the computer giant's local subsidiary.
